message.reasoning:
I'm sitting at Free Parking with $395 and no houses left, mapping out the upcoming board spaces ahead - Kentucky, Chance, Indiana, Illinois, mortgaged B&O, Atlantic, mortgaged Ventnor and Water Works, Marvin Gardens owned by player 4, Jail, my own Pacific, unowned North Carolina, PCC, and my Pennsylvania and Short Line properties.

Looking further around the board, the real danger is player 1's orange and pink monopolies after they pass Go - their rents on St. James, Tennessee, New York, Virginia, States and St. Charles could run $450-800 if I land there. I'm weighing whether to unmortgage Pacific or Penn, but since I have no houses to leverage for rent income, I decide it's smarter to just hold my cash buffer against those dangerous rents and end my turn, maybe picking up North Carolina if I happen to land on it later.
